subject: ⏰ Grant Deadline Approaching — $grant_name ($days_remaining days)
body:
Dear $pi_name,

This is a reminder that the deadline for the grant application below is approaching. Please make sure the submission package is complete and signed off well in advance.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GRANT DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Application ID:    $application_id
Grant:             $grant_name
Funding Body:      $funding_agency
Requested Amount:  £$requested_amount
Deadline:          $deadline
Days Remaining:    $days_remaining
Current Status:    $status
Department:        $department

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FINAL CHECKS

  • Case for support and CV files attached and within page limits.
  • Budget approved by departmental finance lead.
  • Co-investigators have signed the participation form.
  • Research Services has been copied on the final submission.
  • All ethics, data-management, and IP forms are in place.

If you need an extension, escalation, or last-minute review, contact Research Services immediately — last-day support cannot be guaranteed.

Kind regards,
Research Services Office
